method: ARM (start a build | resume after a crash | close a phase) x ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | contextual), in both languages the founder drives the work in. Negatives are the doors next to it: tiny work (tdd-dev), a bug (bugfix), a plan not written or not accepted yet (plan), shipping a gated branch (ship), a review with no build (review).
